latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Confluence Integration skill for OpenClaw.

- Provides Confluence REST API operations using lightweight shell scripts (curl-based, no Python dependencies)
- Supports searching pages (CQL), creating, updating, and retrieving pages
- Enables listing spaces and managing attachments on pages
- Configuration via environment variables (Confluence URL, user, API key/password)
- Includes example usage and CQL queries in documentation
